items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: He's with Zack Whyte's band in Cincinnati

ctx.x: What's his name? He's dead now. George Stevens - I don't think you know him. George Stevens. Oh yeah, another one, he's living now but he's not playing. He wrote me a letter. He's with Zack Whyte's band in Cincinnati and he was coming to New York. His name was Stumpy Brady. You know him.
